channel.title: Utah Business – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Utah Business – Bias and Credibility (utahbusiness.com)

item.title: Forty Under 40: Utah’s rising business stars in 2026
item.description: These Utah Business honorees redefine what it means to lead with vision and purpose.

item.title: Employee training and workforce development for Utah businesses with Custom Fit
item.description: Find out how the statewide Custom Fit program can help your company cost-effectively train employees to improve efficiency, boost profits and fill your workforce needs for less.

item.title: Card My Yard named a Top Franchise for Women in 2026 by Franchise Business Review
item.description: Celebration-focused brand earns high marks from female franchise owners for its flexibility, purpose, and growing demand.

item.title: Wasatch Peaks receives Samuel H. Barker Legacy Award for $2M OTECH donation
item.description: Wasatch Peaks Credit Union was honored with the Samuel H. Barker Legacy Award by Ogden-Weber Technical College in recognition of its $2 million contribution to support students.

item.title: Local high school entrepreneurs compete in Shark Tank-style pitch competition at Loveland Living Planet Aquarium
item.description: Eleven teams of high school entrepreneurs pitched their business ideas to a panel of local business leaders during the South Valley Chamber’s annual Shark Tank-style competition at the Loveland Living Planet Aquarium’s new event center.

item.title: Improving the innovative workplaces of Utah companies with mental health resources
item.description: These six Utah companies are pioneering efforts in supporting employee mental health — creating environments that prioritize well-being through forward-thinking strategies and mental health resources that go beyond conventional practices.

item.title: Rizz Lending closes $300 million warehouse facility, accelerating growth in exotic and collector car financing
item.description: Rizz Lending, a specialty auto finance company focused on high-value exotic, luxury, and collector vehicles, announced the closing of a $300 million warehouse credit facility, significantly expanding the company’s lending capacity as it continues scaling its data-driven, AI-enabled financing platform and dealer partnerships across the United States.

item.title: Ensign College student wins $20,000 grand prize at Tim Draper Utah Entrepreneur Challenge
item.description: Ensign College students are building award-winning businesses because they are taught in an applied, mentor-driven, employer-aligned environment.

item.title: KBS completes sale of 210,938-SF renovated historic office asset with multifamily development potential in downtown Salt Lake City
item.description: The transaction demonstrates KBS’ track record of sourcing distinctive assets, executing strategic upgrades, and achieving timely exits during evolving capital market cycles.

item.title: Utah nightlife: Creative workshops, family activities, game shows and more
item.description: Explore Utah’s distinctive family-friendly nightlife with engaging activities, from game show battles to creative workshops to artisan experiences.

item.title: Paid Ad: Rent Unmasked: How Federal Regulators Aim to Replace “Base Rent” with Total Transparency
item.description: Utah renters often encounter hidden rental costs, prompting the FTC to initiate a rulemaking process for price transparency.

item.title: Artemis II launch: Northrop Grumman in Utah built rocket boosters to help with space exploration
item.description: NASA’s Artemis II mission began in early April, marking the first time in more than half a century that humans have flown to the moon, relying on rocket boosters and other systems built in Utah.

item.title: Salt Lake County announces next phase of Salt Palace Convention Center reconstruction, supported by completion of full project team
item.description: Jacobsen Construction and AECOM Hunt join award-winning team to enhance Utah’s premier convention facility — a cornerstone of the Sports, Entertainment, Culture and Convention (SECC) District.

item.title: UTA Transit Exhibit set to open at the Children’s Museum
item.description: Discovery Gateway Children’s Museum is unveiling a new UTA Transit Exhibit in partnership with Utah Transit Authority.

item.title: Dibble expands Mountain West footprint with new Orem, Utah office
item.description: Dibble, a multidisciplinary infrastructure consulting firm, announced the opening of its new Utah office at 1275 W 1600 N, Suite 100, Orem, UT 84057.
